entry.title: Market brief — Friday 6 November 2026 close (last session; markets shut 8 Nov)
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: Friday 6 November 2026's verified close — Nifty 50 25,030.35, Sensex 81,028.02, the rupee at 93.91 per dollar, 24K gold at ₹1,41,452 per 10 g and 999 silver at ₹1,82,868 per kg. Every figure checked against two independent sources. Markets were shut on Sunday 8 November 2026 for Diwali Laxmi Pujan, so this is the last verified session.
